description: Case-level validation projection for closure analysis and a future population join. Full source records remain in raw storage.

unique_key.description: Service-request identifier and dataset-wide primary key; keep as text.
unique_key.missing_policy: Missing identifiers quarantine the record; never generate replacement IDs.
unique_key.invalid_policy_reason: A stable nonempty identifier is necessary for deduplication and provenance.

created_date.description: Recorded creation timestamp; defines the selected scope and created_month.
created_date.missing_policy: Missing creation dates quarantine the record; never impute them.
created_date.invalid_policy_reason: An invalid creation date prevents scope checks and closure-duration calculation.

closed_date.description: Recorded administrative closure timestamp, possibly absent.
closed_date.missing_policy: Keep missing dates null; derived closure_hours stays null, never zero.
closed_date.invalid_policy_reason: A malformed nonmissing closure date cannot be used as a trustworthy outcome.

agency.description: Responsible agency code; trim and normalize case, without an NYPD-only filter.
agency.missing_policy: Missing agency codes quarantine the record; do not infer them from the sample.
agency.invalid_policy_reason: Responsibility is a core analytical dimension; the sample is not a global domain list.

agency_name.description: Optional readable label for the responsible agency.
agency_name.missing_policy: Keep null and flag the missing value; do not copy or guess an agency name.
agency_name.invalid_policy_reason: The agency code remains usable when its descriptive label is invalid.

complaint_type.description: Problem category; permitted values come from source.complaint_types in settings.
complaint_type.missing_policy: Missing categories quarantine the record; no category imputation.
complaint_type.invalid_policy_reason: Missing or out-of-scope categories prevent the intended complaint comparison.

descriptor.description: Optional problem detail within the complaint category.
descriptor.missing_policy: Keep null and flag missing detail; retain the service request.
descriptor.invalid_policy_reason: Complaint type and dates remain useful without the optional problem detail.

status.description: Reported workflow status; preserve known and new nonmissing labels.
status.missing_policy: Treat configured sentinels such as Unspecified as null with a flag.
status.invalid_policy_reason: Unknown status alone does not invalidate a usable recorded closure date.

incident_zip.description: Five-digit ZIP text used for a future population join; leading zeros are preserved.
incident_zip.missing_policy: Null, blank and configured placeholders remain null with a visible flag.
incident_zip.invalid_policy_reason: An unusable ZIP becomes null with a flag; retain the case for non-ZIP analyses.

borough.description: Reported borough; normalize to the five listed NYC borough names when usable.
borough.missing_policy: Keep unknown borough null with a flag; do not infer it from ZIP in this stage.
borough.invalid_policy_reason: An unusable borough becomes null with a flag; a configured borough scope remains a hard rule.

latitude.description: Optional latitude converted from source text to a finite floating-point number.
latitude.missing_policy: Keep missing coordinates null; a partial latitude/longitude pair becomes fully null.
latitude.invalid_policy_reason: Global bounds detect impossible coordinates without rejecting an otherwise usable case.

longitude.description: Optional longitude converted from source text to a finite floating-point number.
longitude.missing_policy: Keep missing coordinates null; a partial latitude/longitude pair becomes fully null.
longitude.invalid_policy_reason: Global bounds do not prove a location is inside NYC; no invented NYC bounding box is used.

location_type.description: Optional category describing the incident setting.
location_type.missing_policy: Keep null with a flag; no modal-category imputation.
location_type.invalid_policy_reason: The incident setting is auxiliary and does not determine closure-duration validity.

open_data_channel_type.description: Submission channel such as ONLINE, MOBILE, PHONE, OTHER or UNKNOWN.
open_data_channel_type.missing_policy: Keep absent values null with a flag; the literal UNKNOWN is retained as a category.
open_data_channel_type.invalid_policy_reason: An unusable value becomes null; new string labels are not rejected using sample-only categories.

resolution_description.description: Optional administrative narrative; its presence is not proof of issue resolution.
resolution_description.missing_policy: Keep null with a flag; do not fabricate resolution narratives.
resolution_description.invalid_policy_reason: The closure timestamp, not the narrative's presence, defines recorded closure duration.

resolution_action_updated_date.description: Optional timestamp of an administrative resolution update.
resolution_action_updated_date.missing_policy: Keep missing values null with a flag; do not substitute the closure date.
resolution_action_updated_date.invalid_policy_reason: An invalid optional update timestamp becomes null; it is not the duration endpoint.

city.description: Optional source locality label; it is not a replacement for borough.
city.missing_policy: Keep null with a flag; do not populate it from the borough or ZIP.
city.invalid_policy_reason: Locality spelling is not used to silently exclude otherwise in-scope cases.

created_month.description: YYYY-MM from the floating created_date; no timezone conversion.

closure_hours.description: Difference of recorded floating closed_date and created_date in hours; null when closure is missing, zero is valid, no timezone conversion.

has_recorded_closure.description: Whether a usable closed_date is present; does not prove the issue was resolved.

quality_flags.description: Sorted warning codes for optional fields and status/date inconsistencies.

dataset_rules.projection: Retain the 17 declared source fields plus four derived fields. Extra source fields stay in immutable raw files and are listed in the later validation report.
dataset_rules.scope: created_date >= source.start_date and created_date < source.end_date_exclusive; complaint and optional borough restrictions come from source settings. closed_date is not restricted to this creation interval.
dataset_rules.normalization: Trim surrounding text whitespace and compare missing tokens case-insensitively before validation; apply uppercase only where explicitly declared. Record optional repairs as quality flags.
dataset_rules.presence: required_presence concerns batch-level source structure; nullable concerns an individual normalized record. Absence of optional keys alone does not prove schema drift.
dataset_rules.uniqueness: unique_key is unique across all accepted records, not just within a batch. Equal-looking complaints with different IDs are not duplicates.
dataset_rules.duplicates: Among individually valid records, retain the first ID occurrence in stored batch/row order. Quarantine later identical canonical full raw records as DUPLICATE_RECORD, or differing raw records with the same ID as DUPLICATE_KEY_CONFLICT. This is deterministic retention, not a claim to select the newest revision.
dataset_rules.closure: Quarantine closed_date before created_date. Allow a zero interval, preserve missing closure as null, and keep long positive durations for subsequent EDA rather than an arbitrary upper cutoff.
dataset_rules.coordinates: Require finite latitude/longitude within declared global bounds when present. An unusable optional value becomes null with a flag; null both coordinates if only one survives.
dataset_rules.status: Flag status/closed_date inconsistencies without inventing closure dates or rejecting the case solely on status. has_recorded_closure is not proof of real-world resolution.
dataset_rules.zip: The ZIP pattern is a syntactic check only; actual reference coverage and ZIP/ZCTA correspondence are assessed during the population join.
dataset_rules.serialization: datetime is the logical type. JSONL later stores normalized ISO timestamps with microsecond precision because JSON has no native datetime type.
dataset_rules.stage_boundary: This contract documents the next validation stage. Loading or displaying it does not clean records, produce quarantine outputs or complete acquisition.
